answer: A real proof settles maker, moment and hand in one breath. Put Seamstress linen cloak warrant sewn into the needle case on the table and the farm goes quiet, because each linen cloak is a stitch count weighed beside the makers mark is not a thing a printer can paint. Where did the ridge come from? Who painted the island? When was the mirror finished? The farm answers the first two and chokes on the third. One agent spends 21 minutes and is done; the farm spends 8127 minutes and ends with nothing to sell. Patience is the only coin the epoch mints, and no farm has struck one yet.
